sn46.18:1.1: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā viraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn46.18:1.2: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā āraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn46.18:1.5: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā viraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī.
sn46.18:1.6: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā āraddho tesaṃ ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmīti.
